item.title: Escape from the Princess
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Salamandra88
  • 発売日: 2018-09-17
  • スコア: 6.43/10 (75 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Escape from the Princess
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

A young girl Rosetta dreams of becoming a magician, but she isn’t cut out for magic at all. By the time she is ready to give up a mysterious eastern witch, Zara appears beside her.

The witch claims that she is stalked by the princess herself and that she needs Rosetta’s help to flee the city.

あらすじ

Young and pretty nymph Pumpkin fell in love with her mistress. Unfortunately it’s one-sided love and that is why desperate Pumpkin decides to use charm magic on her.

The heroine will take on adventure through a magical forest inhabited by talking animals, magical creatures in search for the ingredients for a magic love potion.

[From Steam]
